Garner's recovery is running ahead of schedule - he started for Everton in midweek against Preston after Hayden Hackney went off with a rolled ankle that has him touch-and-go for the weekend. Moyes still says he is not yet trusting Garner for a full 90 minutes, so it is good news for his minutes rather than a nailed-on start.

Crystal Palace's first-choice striker Mateta is out injured after a hamstring problem in training - reports range from four weeks to into October - which pushes free agent Jorgen Strand Larsen into the central striker role with Eddie Nketiah in support behind him. Both are more nailed on than the model's mid-table next5 figures suggest if you need a FWD option.

Leeds centre-back Joe Rodon was forced off with a hamstring injury in the 34th minute of Sunday's 1-1 draw with Brentford, and Ilia Gruev is separately out into mid-September with a meniscus problem - Farke's other fit centre-back options are Muharemovic, Bijol and Elvedi. Two of Bijol's rivals for the shirt are now sidelined, backing up rather than contradicting his 0.85 availability on your dash

Liverpool sign Bradley Barcola from PSG for GBP123m, the window's biggest deal. He is NOT in the draft pool yet - FPL has not registered him (Watkins' Saudi move is five days old and still unposted). When he lands the model will underrate him for four gameweeks: no PL history means a 0.40 play prior and a 0.68 new-club discount, so expect a projection near the bottom of your board. Ignore it.
